description: Create outreach copy from a selected static message or generation prompt. Omit template_key to use the product default; list alternatives only when the user asks. Voice, structure, and length come from the template. Pure static messages are free; generation prompts and a static AI hook cost one credit per successful AI generation. A subsidiary ticker resolves upward to the corporate family; when the subsidiary or the lead's work email identifies the lead's own company, that company's evidence is used first (lead_company). The response reports evidence_mode (specific, or general when no company fact fit this person), plain-English warnings to relay to the user (for example a lead whose email belongs to another company), and used_excerpts with the text of each cited excerpt. Optional lead personalization supports selected_lead or lead_selector. Set include_emails with max_email_credits to also reveal the selected lead's work email in the same call (selected_lead_email; 1 credit only when an address is delivered; the response reports email_status, including no_lead when no lead was resolved; this call can take up to ~3 minutes, so if it times out do not blindly retry: check get_dealmap_emails with dry_run for the lead, which is free for already-unlocked addresses). When drafting for several prospects or leads, run up to 10 craft_outreach calls in parallel rather than one at a time; limited to 60 requests per minute per API key — on a 429, wait Retry-After seconds and retry only the rejected calls. Requires "read" and "outreach" scopes. Returns 409 analysis_unavailable when analysis is not available for this company in the current results; tell the user briefly and do not retry. Before showing a draft, check its claims against used_excerpts. If a claim is wrong, fix it in the draft and say in one line what you changed; don't append a checklist of things for the user to verify.

include_emails.description: Also reveal the selected lead's work email and return it as selected_lead_email (and selected_lead.work_email). An address is charged 1 credit only when one is delivered; an address already unlocked or supplied by the team is free. Requires max_email_credits.

node_id.description: Select stakeholder by exact node_id from get_dealmap

level.description: Select top-ranked stakeholder within this seniority level
Level bucket used with full_name for exact match

stakeholder_role.description: Select the top-pick stakeholder with this buying committee role (e.g., "Economic Buyer", "Decision Maker", "Champion")

lead_selector.description: Optional selector to auto-resolve a stakeholder from the DealMap. Paste exactly one object: {"node_id":"..."} OR {"level":"vp"} OR {"full_name":"Jane Doe","level":"director"} OR {"stakeholder_role":"Economic Buyer"}. The stakeholder_role selector picks the top-pick for that buying committee role. Used only when selected_lead (which is preferred) is absent.

max_email_credits.description: Required with include_emails: the most credits you allow for the email (0 or 1). If the email would cost more, the call stops with 422 before anything is charged. Call get_dealmap_emails with dry_run first when unsure.

product_id.description: The product ID to generate outreach for

selected_lead.description: Optional full stakeholder object from get_dealmap for personalization. If provided alongside lead_selector, this field wins. Leaving selected_lead blank in Inspector is allowed.

template_key.description: Optional template_key returned by list_outreach_templates. Omit to use the product default; use "system_default" to explicitly select the built-in template.

ticker.description: Target company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: craft_outreach
